title: Orchestrating existing HR systems.
summary: 90% less admin work; starts 12 days sooner; 60% lower transfer cost; up to 70% more accurate.

spec.problem: Hiring managers spent most of an internal transfer on administrative steps spread across HR systems. Transfers were slow and costly to process.
spec.changed: An AI-driven workflow now coordinates the steps across the existing systems. No system was replaced.
spec.systems: Oracle HR systems, orchestrated by IBM.
spec.measured: Hiring-manager admin time, days to start, cost per transfer, process accuracy.
spec.result: **90% less admin work; starts 12 days sooner; 60% lower transfer cost; up to 70% more accurate.** Company-reported, October 2026.

evidence: Reported by the company or the press, as published. Not an xGold engagement and not an outcome a new client should expect.
